headline: Hi，我是赵润涵~
about:
You can also call me Roy Zhao,
我是一个光信系本科在读的SZUer，在这里分享一些小知识和我的日常；

16型人格：INFP ｜ 星座：狮子座🦁

个人喜好有摄影🎞️、羽毛球🏸、徒步🏔️、音乐剧🎫等等～
保持探索中，梦想环游世界🌍；
最喜吃折耳根香菜火锅牛肉🐮、辣子鸡🐔和三文鱼🍣！

更多相片存放在相册中，欢迎浏览我的相册主页！
我的兴趣包括非线性光学、大气科学、叠层成像等，欢迎同我交流！
aboutEn:
You may also call me Roy,
I am an undergraduate majoring in Optoelectronic Information and a proud member of Shenzhen University (SZU). Here I share some bits of knowledge and my daily life;

MBTI:INFP | Sign:Leo🦁

My personal hobbies include photography 🎞️, badminton 🏸, hiking 🏔️, musical theatre 🎫, and more.
I keep exploring, with a dream of traveling around the world 🌍;
My favorite foods are hotpot beef with fish mint and cilantro 🐮, spicy chicken 🐔, and salmon 🍣.

More photos are kept in my albums, and you are welcome to visit my album homepage.
My interests include nonlinear optics, atmospheric science, ptychography, and more, and you are welcome to exchange ideas with me.
